title: Mameushi-kun
justification: Mameushi-kun (2007-2008) is a 52-episode NHK children's short (AniList 12185, TV_SHORT, not adult). The node sent it onto Detective Conan's TVDB series 72454, its episodes 1-6 by rows onto the Kaito Kid specials and the rest by default onto Conan's season 0, and onto Conan's TMDB show. TVDB carries no Mameushi-kun: the TheTVDB search for まめうしくん and Mameushi and SkyHook's search find nothing, so it takes the marker `other`.
